cues.text: AI analyses telemetry to forecast load or detect anomalies.
IoT provides sensor data, SDN programmes routes and policy, NFV and cloud supply scalable functions, and five G with MEC supports access and nearby processing.
Imagine the industrial sequence in the notes: a sensor feeds edge or MEC inference, which creates a local maintenance alert, while the cloud handles trend analysis.
The network controller prioritises approved traffic.
Consider privacy, attack surface, model mistakes and closed-loop safeguards.
Automated network control needs bounded policies, audit and rollback.
For the capstone validation, use SNMP version three and traffic tests to verify link utilisation and priority treatment.
Measure local processing latency versus cloud latency.
Disconnect the WAN inside the simulator and verify that local alerts remain available and queued events reconcile after reconnection.
Compare measured cloud-bound bytes to the raw-stream baseline rather than guessing bandwidth savings.
Record the topology, steps, observations and limitations.
